title: Brew of animal whispers
content:
# Brew of animal whispers

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadTamer | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Animal whispers x1 | Duration: 10m | Cooldown: 0s | Other Effect(s): x2 taming speed

# Introduction

Brew of animal whispers is a Mountain-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Animal whispers.

## Recipe

Mead base: Animal whispers is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 5 Onion
• 10 Carrot
• 1 Pungent pebbles
Six Brews of animal whispers are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Consuming it makes the taming process twice as fast (15 minutes instead of 30) for all animals in the vicinity (60-meter range). If a creature is in range of multiple players with the buff, the taming speed is multiplied by two for each of them (x2, x4, x8, etc.).

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
